ns2:section.sectionText: Digital Photography Foundations for Media - Have you always wanted to take better pictures? Do you want to know how to use all the features of a digital camera? Are you interested in using your photographs in ebooks, magazines, on the web or the walls of an art gallery? Then this hands-on class is what you¿ve been waiting for. This course is designed to acquaint you with the fundamentals of digital photography for media. Instruction will include techniques to produce photographs; the conception and planning of pictures; the pictorial coverage of events and human interest situations; and the planning and execution of photo layouts in print and on the web. No prior photographic experience expected or required. Cameras will be provided.
